# Environment variable reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_env_reference.py. Do not edit by hand: run

Every variable PySOAR's backend reads, generated from the code. Install guides: [compose](compose.md), [Kubernetes](kubernetes.md).

Secret = yes means the value is a credential or contains one: keep it out of git, out of ConfigMaps and out of logs (on Kubernetes it belongs in the Secret named by `secret.existingSecret`).

## 1. Application settings (`src/core/config.py`)

Read by every backend process (api, worker, scheduler, flower and the migration command) from the process environment, and from a `.env` file in the working directory (`/app` in the backend image). Names are case-insensitive; unknown names are ignored. List and object settings take JSON.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Validation and production rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `APP_NAME` | str | `PySOAR` | no |  |
| `APP_ENV` | str | `development` | no | `production` (exact string) arms every rule marked Production in this table. The backend image sets `APP_ENV=production`; a value in `.env` or the container environment overrides it. (`src/core/config.py`) |
| `DEBUG` | bool | `false` | no | Strings `release`, `prod`, `production` mean false; `debug`, `dev`, `development` mean true; other values are parsed as a boolean. |
| `SECRET_KEY` | str | `change-me-in-production` | yes | **Production:** The api refuses to start when the value's Shannon entropy is below 3.0 bits per character or it contains `change`, `default`, `password`, `secret`, `admin`, `test`, `example` or `placeholder` (case-insensitive). The defaults fail this check. (`src/core/config.py`) Secret: signs sessions and internal tokens. |
| `API_V1_PREFIX` | str | `/api/v1` | no |  |
| `HOST` | str | `127.0.0.1` | no |  |
| `PORT` | int | `8000` | no |  |
| `WORKERS` | int | `1` | no |  |
| `DATABASE_URL` | str | `sqlite+aiosqlite:///./pysoar.db` | yes | **Production:** For a PostgreSQL URL the api refuses to start when the password is empty, the bundled default `pysoar`, shorter than 12 characters or contains a weak word; `deploy/configure-env.sh` generates a random `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` and writes it into both. (`src/core/config.py`) Secret: contains the database password. |
| `DATABASE_SSL_MODE` | str | `prefer` | no | When `APP_ENV=production`, must be `require`, `verify-full` or `disable`, or the settings fail to load (every process that imports them exits). On PostgreSQL the value is passed to asyncpg as its `ssl` argument, unless `DATABASE_URL` already carries `ssl=` or `sslmode=`, which then wins. (`src/core/database.py`) |
| `REDIS_URL` | str | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | yes | Secret: contains the Redis password when Redis requires one. |
| `CELERY_BROKER_URL` | str | `redis://localhost:6379/1` | yes | Secret: contains the Redis password when Redis requires one. |
| `CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND` | str | `redis://localhost:6379/2` | yes | Secret: contains the Redis password when Redis requires one. |
| `JWT_SECRET_KEY` | str | `jwt-secret-change-in-production` | yes | **Production:** The api refuses to start when the value's Shannon entropy is below 3.0 bits per character or it contains `change`, `default`, `password`, `secret`, `admin`, `test`, `example` or `placeholder` (case-insensitive). The defaults fail this check. (`src/core/config.py`) Secret: signs access and refresh tokens. |
| `JWT_ALGORITHM` | `HS256` \| `HS384` \| `HS512` | `HS256` | no |  |
| `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` | int | `30` | no |  |
| `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS` | int | `7` | no |  |
| `ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | **Production:** Required: the api refuses to start without it. It must be the base64 encoding of exactly 32 bytes (`openssl rand -base64 32`). (`src/main.py`) Secret: encrypts stored credentials; losing it loses them. |
| `ACCOUNT_LOCKOUT_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | int | `5` | no |  |
| `ACCOUNT_LOCKOUT_DURATION_SECONDS` | int | `900` | no |  |
| `PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` | int | `12` | no |  |
| `FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL` | str | `admin@pysoar.example` | no | **Production:** The api refuses to start when the address is one the sign-in form refuses (email-validator rejects special-use domains such as .local, .test and .invalid), because the administrator it creates could never sign in. Read only while the `users` table is empty. (`src/core/config.py`) |
| `FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | str | `changeme123` | yes | **Production:** The api refuses to start when its Shannon entropy is below 3.0 bits per character or it contains a weak word (change, default, password, secret, admin, test, example, placeholder), so the default `changeme123` is refused. The account is created only when the `users` table is empty, and must change its password at first login. (`src/core/config.py`) Secret: initial password of the first administrator. |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | list[str] (JSON) | `["http://localhost:3000","http://localhost:8000"]` | no | A JSON list, or a comma-separated string. **Production:** Origins containing `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` are dropped. (`src/main.py`) |
| `OT_DISCOVERY_ALLOWED_CIDRS` | list[str] (JSON) | `[]` | no | A JSON list, or a comma-separated string; empty means `[]`. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | str | `INFO` | no |  |
| `LOG_FORMAT` | str | `json` | no |  |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | int | `60` | no |  |
| `VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `SHODAN_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `GREYNOISE_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `URLSCAN_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `HIBP_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `DARKWEB_MARKETPLACE_FEED_URL` | str (optional) | unset | no |  |
| `SMTP_HOST` | str | `smtp.gmail.com` | no |  |
| `SMTP_PORT` | int | `587` | no |  |
| `SMTP_USER` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: SMTP login. |
| `SMTP_PASSWORD` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: SMTP password. |
| `SMTP_FROM` | str | `noreply@pysoar.local` | no |  |
| `SMTP_TLS` | bool | `true` | no |  |
| `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: the URL is the credential. |
| `TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: the URL is the credential. |
| `ELASTICSEARCH_URL` | str (optional) | unset | no |  |
| `ELASTICSEARCH_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `SPLUNK_HOST` | str (optional) | unset | no |  |
| `SPLUNK_TOKEN` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider token. |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: AWS credential. |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: AWS credential. |
| `AWS_REGION` | str | `us-east-1` | no |  |
| `LLM_PROVIDER` | `anthropic` \| `gemini` \| `openai` \| `ollama` | `gemini` | no |  |
| `LLM_MODEL` | str (optional) | unset | no |  |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | str (optional) | unset | yes | Secret: provider API key. |

## 2. Variables read directly from the environment

These are read with `os.environ` / `os.getenv` outside `Settings`, so they come from the process environment only: a `.env` file is not read for them unless docker compose passes it (`env_file:`), as it does for the api, worker, scheduler and flower. Where a name is also a setting in section 1, the `Settings` value is used first.

| Variable | In-code default | Secret | Read at |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ABUSECH_AUTH_KEY` | unset | yes | `src/darkweb/engine.py` `abusech_auth_key()` via `_env_value()` |
| `ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY` (also a setting) | unset | yes | `src/intel/providers.py` `platform_key()` |
| `ARCHIVE_DIR` | `/app/archives` | no | `src/siem/storage.py` `apply_retention()` |
| `BACKUP_DIR` | `/app/backups` | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/backup.py` |
| `DARKWEB_MARKETPLACE_FEED_URL` (also a setting) | unset | no | `src/darkweb/engine.py` `marketplace_feed_url()` via `_env_value()` |
| `DFIR_UPLOAD_ROOT` | `/app/uploads/dfir` | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/dfir.py`<br>`src/dfir/storage.py` `evidence_root()` |
| `EVIDENCE_UPLOAD_DIR` | `uploads/evidence` | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/audit_evidence.py` |
| `HIBP_API_KEY` (also a setting) | unset | yes | `src/darkweb/engine.py` `hibp_api_key()` via `_env_value()` |
| `INGEST_WORKERS` | `1` | no | `src/main.py` `lifespan()` |
| `MAX_FILE_SIZE` | `52428800` | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/case_management.py` |
| `NVD_API_KEY` | unset | yes | `src/supplychain/vulnlookup.py` `lookup_components()`<br>`src/supplychain/vulnlookup.py` `provider_status()` |
| `OTX_API_KEY` | unset | yes | `src/darkweb/engine.py` `otx_api_key()` via `_env_value()`<br>`src/intel/providers.py` `platform_key()` |
| `OT_ICS_ADVISORY_FEED_URL` | unset | no | `src/ot_security/advisories.py` `feed_url()` |
| `PYSOAR_AGENT_TOKEN_DIR` | `/app/data/agent` | no | `src/agents/sim_seeder.py` |
| `PYSOAR_COMMIT` | `""` | no | `src/core/version.py` `get_commit()` |
| `PYSOAR_DB_POOL` | `""` | no | `src/core/database.py` `_create_engine()` |
| `PYSOAR_DISABLE_NETWORK_SCAN` | unset | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/ot_security.py` `bulk_discover_assets()`<br>`src/ot_security/engine.py` `discover_assets()` |
| `PYSOAR_KUBE_CA_BUNDLE` | unset | no | `src/container_security/kube.py` `_ssl_context()` |
| `PYSOAR_KUBE_VERIFY_TLS` | `true` | no | `src/container_security/kube.py` `_ssl_context()` |
| `PYSOAR_PUBLIC_URL` | `https://pysoar.it.com` | no | `src/phishing_sim/tracking.py` `public_base_url()`<br>`src/services/notifications.py` `_public_base_url()` |
| `PYSOAR_STIG_CONTENT_DIR` | `/app/data/stig/xccdf` | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/stig.py` |
| `REDIS_URL` (also a setting) | unset | yes | `src/main.py` `lifespan()` |
| `SIEM_DEFAULT_ORG_ID` | unset | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/siem.py` `_resolve_default_siem_org()` |

| `UPLOAD_DIR` | `uploads/attachments` | no | `src/api/v1/endpoints/case_management.py` |
| `VAULT_ROLE` | `pysoar` | no | `src/core/secrets.py` `authenticate_kubernetes()` |

Reads whose variable name is computed at runtime (not a fixed name, so not listed above):

- `src/core/secrets.py` `get_secret()`

## 3. docker compose interpolation (`docker-compose.yml`)

docker compose substitutes these into `docker-compose.yml` itself, from the shell environment or the `.env` file next to the compose file. They configure the stack, not the application, unless the compose file also passes them to a container.

| Variable | Behaviour when unset | Secret | Used by services |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | required (compose refuses to start) | yes | `grafana` |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | default `pysoar` | yes | `postgres` |
| `PYSOAR_COMMIT` | default `unknown` | no | `api`, `flower`, `frontend`, `scheduler`, `worker` |
| `PYSOAR_IMAGE_TAG` | default `local` | no | `api`, `flower`, `frontend`, `scheduler`, `worker` |
| `REDIS_PASSWORD` | no default (empty when unset) | yes | `redis` |
| `SIEM_SYSLOG_ENABLED` | default `true` | no | `api` |
| `SIEM_SYSLOG_PORT` | default `5514` | no | `api` |
